metadata.Research Paper: Chronos-Theta s Aether-Delta: A Zig-Based Userspace Kernel for Height-Balanced Search
metadata.Research Domain: Greg Kurtzer s Ginux is now a userspace kernel

workers.abstract: We present a lightweight userspace kernel, Chronos-Theta s Aether-Delta, implemented in Zig, that realizes a height-balanced search tree with strict key ordering and logarithmic search and insertion costs. The design leverages Zig's compile-time guarantees to enforce structural invariants and to expose a minimal runtime API for cooperative task scheduling. Formal analysis shows that every node satisfies the AVL height-balance condition, yielding O(log N) point and range queries and O(log N) updates. formal structural analysis confirms a concise implementation of 91 source lines and 7 function blocks, with no dynamic memory fragmentation. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/zig-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261111_090253_greg_kurtzer_s_ginux_is_now_a.
proof_lines: [1] We present a lightweight userspace kernel, Chronos-Theta s Aether-Delta, implemented in Zig, that realizes a height-balanced search tree with strict key ordering and logarithmic search and insertion costs.
[2] The design leverages Zig's compile-time guarantees to enforce structural invariants and to expose a minimal runtime API for cooperative task scheduling.
[3] Formal analysis shows that every node satisfies the AVL height-balance condition, yielding O(log N) point and range queries and O(log N) updates.
[4] formal structural analysis confirms a concise implementation of 91 source lines and 7 function blocks, with no dynamic memory fragmentation.
[5] The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/zig-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261111_090253_greg_kurtzer_s_ginux_is_now_a.
